recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-2968; revisit only if a future work group decision deliberately restores a local Encounter.priority value set.
issue_request: FHIR-2968 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Encounter and asked that valueset-encounter-priority stop using the copied Diet name and http://hl7.org/fhir/diet code-system URI.
initial_application: Commit 1cf591a5ee changed the old value set name from Diet to Encounter Priority and moved the system away from diet; commit 7e4c173af1 corrected that system to http://hl7.org/fhir/encounter-priority.
additional_context: FHIR-3122 reported the same wrong code-system URL and explicitly cited tracker #2968 as its application path. Later FHIR-8621/source history deleted the local encounter-priority value set and changed Encounter.priority to bind to v3 ActPriority.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because FHIR-2968's requested correction is already reflected in history and the current active Encounter source no longer has source/encounter/valueset-encounter-priority.xml, source/encounter/codesystem-encounter-priority.xml, or a diet/encounter-priority URL reference for Encounter.priority.
